title: Can I BEAT Chaturaji Chess?
summary: First Chaturaji video (chess.com 4-player point variant): four players each with half an army on one 8x8 board, capturing for points (on-screen values), the boat moves like a rook. Placement scoring: 1st = 3 wins, 2nd = 1 win, 3rd = 1 loss, 4th = 3 losses. Goal: three wins. As Yellow (moves third) vs two 1400s and a ~1900 he takes Green's king for points and uses the 'claim win' button when ahead 21-3; overall he gets 1st, 2nd, 2nd... finishing with a win in game 3.
rules: Four players (Red, Blue, Yellow, Green), clockwise turns; each has K, boat, N, B + 4 pawns in a corner; each army's pawns move in a different direction.
Capture points per piece (on-screen: pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 5, boat 5, king 3).
Capturing a king eliminates that player and scores 3; checks matter for who can capture next.
A leader whose margin cannot be overcome gets a 'Claim win' button.
Placement awards: 1st +3 wins, 2nd +1 win, 3rd 1 loss, 4th 3 losses.
win_condition: Most points. Series goal: 3 wins net.

opponent.name: Three online humans (two ~1400, one ~1900)
opponent.avatar_description: Coloured seat tags; remake with three bot seats.

setup: chess.com Chaturaji corner layout (each colour: back row boat, knight, bishop, king; front row 4 pawns) for Red, Blue, Yellow, Green. Player = Yellow.

evidence: SRT 0:00 'four players each get half of a chess Army and players capture pieces for points on screen is the point value... boat piece which moves exactly like a rook... first place gets three wins... my goal is to get three wins'; 0:30 'I get the yellow pieces which means I move third... two 1400s and an almost 1900'; 4:40 'I get the claim win button... 21 to3'; 22:00 'won the first game outright... second place... victory on this third game'.
